official.application_cycle: 4th edition of the RESTART Programme (4.a edicao); applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h; provisional results expected April 2027 per the FCT 2026 contest calendar

official.funding_period: per project, up to 18 months of development
benefits: Maximum funding limit of 50,000 EUR per project
Maximum duration of 18 months of project development
A total budget allocation of 1.6 million EUR for this call
Possibility of associating additional human and/or material resources, according to the funding available and the planned implementation period
eligibility: Be an integrated doctoral researcher of an R&D unit, or hold an employment contract with a State laboratory

Have taken parental leave, including adoption leave, of 120 days or more (in the case of shared parental leave, including shared adoption leave, the applicant must demonstrate having taken, either exclusively or jointly, at least 72 days of leave), between 3 June 2025 inclusive and 1 October 2026 inclusive
The minimum number of days required for each type of leave (120 or 72) must be reached between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive, regardless of the date on which the leave begins or ends
National, foreign and stateless researchers may apply, with the commitment of the host institution

Researchers holding a fellowship contract may provide, as proof of parental leave, a declaration issued by the contracting institution confirming suspension of the research activities funded by the fellowship for an equivalent period; for FCT fellowships this may be replaced by simply indicating the fellowship reference number
requirements: Applications must be submitted by filling out, in English, a specific form available electronically on the myFCT portal
Applications must be filed with the commitment of the host institution

Applications from researchers who, as Principal Investigators or Co-Principal Investigators, are beneficiaries of projects funded or recommended for funding by FCT as of 1 June 2027 shall not be eligible (reference date amended from 1 September 2026 when the Call Notice was republished on 8 October 2026)
Applications that have been selected for funding by FCT or other funding agencies shall not be admitted

Multiple applications based on the same proposal shall not be admitted under this Notice, nor under different Notices where there is an overlap between the respective application submission periods; applications sharing all or part of the work plan are considered multiple
documents: Application form completed in English on myFCT

Proof of parental leave, or for fellowship holders the declaration of suspension of research activities issued by the contracting institution; for FCT fellowships, the fellowship reference instead of the declaration
selection_criteria: Scientific quality, innovative nature and feasibility of the proposed research plan
Merit of the applicant and adequacy of the profile to the proposed research plan
Impact of the research project execution on the researcher's career development
coverage: Competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific fields
Maximum funding of 50,000 EUR per project
Maximum duration of 18 months of project development
Option to associate other human and/or material resources, subject to available funding and planned execution time
application_method: Confirm you meet all three cumulative eligibility requirements at the deadline for the application submission period
Obtain the commitment of the host institution
Check you are not a PI or Co-PI beneficiary of FCT-funded or FCT-recommended projects at the applicable reference date
Prepare proof of the qualifying parental leave, or the equivalent suspension statement for fellowship holders
Complete the dedicated form in English on myFCT
Submit during the application period, 01 October 2026 at 14h to 13 November 2026 at 17h
official.application_route: Complete the dedicated English-language application form on the myFCT portal during the published window, with the host institution's commitment
official.citizenship_residency: Open to national, foreign and stateless researchers, provided the host institution commitment is in place
official.international_eligibility: Yes - FCT expressly states that national, foreign and stateless researchers may apply, with the commitment of the host institution
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Individual R&D projects in all scientific fields; the beneficiary entity must be an R&D unit funded under the FCT Multiannual Funding Programme, a State Laboratory, or an Associate Laboratory with approved status
official.research_requirement: Applicants must pursue and develop an original and innovative research idea; the evaluation criteria explicitly assess the scientific quality, innovative character and feasibility of the proposed research plan
official.description: FCT launches the 4th edition of the RESTART Programme to promote gender equality and equal opportunities through the competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific fields when carried out by researchers who have recently taken parental leave, including adoption leave, supporting them in pursuing and developing an original and innovative research idea under new circumstances.
official.english_requirement: Applications must be submitted by filling out a specific form in English, available electronically on the myFCT portal

tuition_coverage, living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage - the call publishes none of these, because RESTART funds an R&D project held by the beneficiary R&D unit rather than a personal stipend or fee waiver
verification.notes: Read FCT's own call page for the 4th edition of Programa RESTART in both English and Portuguese. Confirmed the EUR 50,000 per-project maximum, the 18-month maximum duration, the EUR 1.6 million allocation, the 1 October to 13 November 2026 application window, the three eligibility conditions and the three evaluation criteria. Also captured the 8 October 2026 republication notice amending the PI/Co-PI eligibility reference date from 1 September 2026 to 1 June 2027.

applicant_utility.summary: RESTART is not a scholarship and pays no stipend: it is a project grant of up to EUR 50,000 for up to 18 months, awarded to your host R&D unit rather than to you personally, so budget for salaries and consumables inside the proposal instead of expecting a monthly payment. You must clear three cumulative tests - a doctorate, integrated doctoral membership of an FCT-funded R&D unit or a State laboratory contract, and a qualifying parental leave of at least 120 days (72 if shared) taken between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 - and you need your host institution's written commitment before you can submit anything. The window runs 1 October to 13 November 2026, and FCT republished the call on 8 October 2026 to push the PI/Co-PI ineligibility reference date out to 1 June 2027, which means more existing grant holders now qualify.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctorate-holding researchers at Portuguese FCT-funded R&D units or State laboratories who took a long parental or adoption leave in the specified window and can persuade their host to commit to the project
application_readiness_checklist: Count your leave days precisely against the 3 June 2025 to 1 October 2026 window and keep the official record - the 120-day and 72-day thresholds are hard cut-offs
Confirm your unit is one of the eligible beneficiary entities: FCT Multiannual Funding Programme unit, State Laboratory, or Associate Laboratory with approved status
Check whether you are a PI or Co-PI on any FCT-funded or FCT-recommended project, using the amended 1 June 2027 reference date from the republished call
Obtain your host institution's commitment in writing before the window opens
If you hold an FCT scholarship, simply cite the fellowship reference instead of chasing a suspension statement
Draft the work plan in English and size it to the 18-month maximum so the budget request stays inside EUR 50,000
E-mail restart@fct.pt if your leave-day count is in any doubt - FCT expressly invites this
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the grant is personal income - the money goes to the beneficiary R&D unit and must be executed as a project
Failing the day-count test because the qualifying days fall just outside 3 June 2025 to 1 October 2026, or because a shared leave did not reach 72 days
Being a PI or Co-PI on another FCT-funded or FCT-recommended project at the reference date
Submitting overlapping work plans under this or another call with a concurrent submission period, which makes both inadmissible
Lacking the host institution's commitment at submission time
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any project costs above the EUR 50,000 cap, and any institutional overhead or indirect costs the beneficiary unit cannot absorb within the award
document_audit: Parental leave proof must cover the qualifying period exactly - for fellowship holders the contracting institution issues a suspension declaration, and for FCT fellowships the reference alone suffices
The application form itself must be completed in English on myFCT, not in Portuguese
The host institution's commitment is a separate, mandatory element that cannot be added after submission
alerts: The call was republished on 8 October 2026: the PI/Co-PI ineligibility reference date moved from 1 September 2026 to 1 June 2027, which changes who is eligible - always work from the republished Call Notice
Overlapping work plans across different calls are fatal: a funding recommendation in one excludes you from the decision process in the others
Applications previously selected for funding by FCT or any other funding agency are not admitted at all
The application window is short and time-stamped in Portuguese time, with a 14h opening and a 17h closing
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Clear the three eligibility tests, secure the host commitment, then complete the English form on myFCT between 1 October 2026 14h and 13 November 2026 17h; results are expected in the 2027 FCT contest calendar
